title: Replication-Horizon Tradeoffs for Policy Contrasts in Partially Observed Panel Decision Processes
banked_reason: terminal:laundering — the arbitrary-pair diameter theorem is an unbounded variational identity without a cardinality cutoff or certified outer truncation, so it does not determine the exact diameter promised by the topic.
gap_reasons: The framing calls the arbitrary-pair diameter exact, but its theorem expresses that diameter as an unbounded supremum of fixed-cardinality programs without a cutoff or certified upper truncation, so it does not determine its value.
Even for fair behavior and deterministic target, the proved diameter remains between 2a^(T−1) and min{2,4a^(T−1)}.
Lower frontiers for other fixed revealed policy pairs are absent; those pairs receive upper bounds only.
proof_attempt_summary: The run constructed stationary full-word twins, a fixed-hard-pair rectangular minimax frontier, heterogeneous-panel population and honest-length extensions, and an arbitrary-policy variational representation. The exact-diameter promise collapsed because the representation leaves an unbounded hidden-cardinality supremum with no cutoff, convergence modulus, or certified outer truncation; the fair-pair constant retains a factor-two gap and other policy pairs lack matching lower frontiers.
tldr: For independent behavior-stationary length-\(T\) records, stationary full-word twins leave a nonzero policy-contrast diameter even with unlimited replication. For the fixed hard pair \(b(1)=L^{-1},e(1)=1\), common-kernel and iid-type in-sample minimax squared risks have order \(F_{N,T}=\min_{0\le k<T}\{a^{2k}+L^k/[N(T-k)]\}\); the iid-type population target adds an \(N^{-1}\) term. Honest expected interval lengths have the corresponding square-root orders, and the risk upper bounds hold for every admissible revealed pair. For every fixed revealed pair, the exact diameter is the supremum over hidden cardinalities of attained finite polynomial-program values. No uniform hidden-cardinality cutoff or certified outer truncation is established. For fair behavior and deterministic target, the explicit numerical value between \(2a^{T-1}\) and \(\min\{2,4a^{T-1}\}\) remains open for \(T\ge2\).
gap: The panel partial-history upper bound is known, while the published converse is for one long trajectory. It does not establish fixed-horizon nonidentification, the last-window transition, or finite-sample honest length.
fill: Prove a centered stationary twin with exactly uninformative initial windows, audit its full-record KL, match the rectangular risk and honest-length envelopes, and characterize the remaining sharp diameter.
